title: What If the Biggest Snake Ever Were Alive Today? Titanoboa

scenes.text: What if a snake longer than a school bus was alive today?
Titanoboa lived in Colombia about 60 million years ago and reached roughly 42 feet.
It weighed about 2,500 pounds, as much as a small car.
But it needed heat. A snake that big needs an average of 86 to 93 degrees Fahrenheit.
Its rainforest averaged about 90 degrees, around five degrees Celsius warmer than modern tropical forests.
Today's tropics run cooler, so a snake that big couldn't stay warm enough. The giant belongs to a hotter world.

description:
What if the biggest snake ever were alive today?
Titanoboa reached about 42 feet and 2,500 pounds, but it needed a rainforest about five degrees warmer than today's.
